summary: Approver attribute mismatch in SCIM mapping prevents onboarding approval flow for several internal tools
summary_detail: New hires and contractor accounts created via SCIM are not triggering the configured approver chain in the internal Access Request UI. The UI reports "No approvers configured" despite group->approver mapping present in RBAC rules. Affects onboarding for multiple teams; manual approvals required.
impact: Blocking: new users cannot be auto-routed to their approvers. Multiple onboarding flows stalled across infra and analytics teams (estimated ~12 users in last 24h). Increases manual work for Identity team and delays project access.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Create user in Okta with onboarding profile (manager populated as LDAP DN) using SCIM provisioner.
2) Wait for SCIM sync to create user in Redwood identity service.
3) Open Access Request UI for any resource that relies on manager-approver workflow.
4) Observe UI message: 'No approvers configured' and request cannot be submitted to approver chain.
observed_behavior: Access Request UI fails to resolve approver list when user.profile.manager contains an LDAP-style DN (e.g., 'cn=Jane Doe,ou=People,dc=example,dc=com'). The identity service lookup returns 0 approvers and logs show a failing attribute normalization step.
expected_behavior: Manager attribute should be normalized to a canonical Okta user id/email during SCIM processing and mapped to the approver policy. Access Request UI should show approver(s) and route approval requests automatically.
logs_and_errors:
Identity-service logs (2026-03-13T14:22:11Z): ERROR scim-provisioner: failed to map manager attribute 'cn=Jane Doe,ou=People,dc=example,dc=com' -> user lookup returned 0 results.
Approver-service logs (2026-03-13T14:22:12Z): WARN approver-resolver: empty candidate set for user id 'okta|null'
Okta System Log event: /api/v1/apps/SCIM/provision - 200 (user created) (link: https://okta.example/logs/ev/0oab12CD)
investigation_notes:
- Hypothesis 1: Recent SCIM mapping change introduced by PR #382 normalized 'manager' to raw LDAP DN instead of Okta user id.
- Hypothesis 2: Approver resolver service expects an email or Okta uid; receiving DN causes lookups to miss.
- Query run against identity DB shows 12 users created in last 24h where manager attribute contains 'cn=' pattern.
- Checked Git history: identity/scim/mappings.js modified in commit 'fc9a8b' (linked PR below).
- Reproduced locally by creating a SCIM stub with manager=DN; identity-service failed to resolve manager -> approver mapping.
- SRE confirms no infra failures (no 5xx spikes). This is mapping / normalization logic bug.
root_cause: SCIM mapping change deployed 2026-03-12 replaced manager normalization rule. Instead of extracting Okta user id/email, the provisioner now stores the raw LDAP DN string. Approver resolver code does an exact match on email/uid and therefore finds zero approvers.
temporary_workaround: Identity team can manually create a 'canonical_manager' attribute on affected user records by using the admin console to point manager to the Okta user id. Manual approvals via admin path enabled: identity-admin -> Requests -> Approve. Onboarding team notified to perform manual routing until fix merges.
permanent_fix_plan:
1) Revert mapping change and reintroduce manager normalization (extract okta:userId or email) - PR #388 to be merged.
2) Add a defensive fallback in approver-resolver: attempt DN->email lookup using LDAP adapter, log telemetry if fallback used.
3) Backfill: script to scan users created 2026-03-12..2026-03-14 with 'cn=' in manager and populate canonical_manager.
4) Add unit/integration tests for SCIM manager mappings and end-to-end approver resolution.
5) Post-deploy: monitor Access Request success rate and Okta event logs for manager mapping errors for 72 hours.
notes_for_oncall: If new SCIM user creation events with manager containing 'cn=' appear, run backfill script and notify requestor list. Escalate to identity-eng if approvals remain unresolved after backfill.
sre_action_items:
Stand up a short-lived metric: 'approver_resolution_failures_by_manager_format' and alert at >5/min. Coordinate with identity-eng to ensure deployment windows for PR #388.
Schedulers: apply canary to us-west then global.
resolution: (pending) workaround in place (manual approvals) and PR #388 under review. Backfill script prepared and awaiting run approval. No permanent fix deployed yet.
follow_up_tasks:
- Merge PR #388 and deploy to canary (assigned: Liam).
- Run backfill script (assigned: Maria P.).
- Add regression tests to CI (assigned: identity-eng).
- Update onboarding runbook with manual steps and detection query (assigned: DevExp).
